writeup: TIC 231976099 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 5.4797 days. Automated analysis of TESS photometry detected a primary eclipse causing the star to dim by 1.80 percent, with a strong signal-to-noise ratio of 62.4. Pixel-level image analysis confirmed the signal at the target location with a peak signal-to-noise of 6.2, though the centroid offset measured 3.6 arcseconds from the target coordinates. No secondary eclipse was detected. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, suggesting it has not been previously cataloged. The pipeline's machine-learning classifier assigned it a score of 0.32 on a scale where higher values indicate greater confidence in the target's authenticity, and the data passed all quality checks without flags.
